item.tib: rig 'dzin sgrab pa'i cha lag chung shes bskang glud btang ba
item.coloph: rig 'dzin thugs kyi sgrub pa las/ chung shes bskang glud bstan pa 'di/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ rnal 'byor mi shig rdo rje rtsal la brgyud/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
